newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron estimates raised.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw said Tuesday it raised its earnings estimates for Micron Electronics Inc to $1.22 a share from $0.96 for fiscal 1997, and to $1.72 a share from $1.60 for fiscal 1998. In 1996 it earned $0.70 a share.
-- It also raised its earnings estimates for the second quarter of fiscal 1997 to $0.28 a share from $0.22, for the third quarter to $0.31 from $0.26, and for the fourth quarter to $0.36 from $0.30.
-- Micron late Monday reported fiscal first quarter earnings of $0.27 a share, up from $0.18 reported a year ago and higher than the consensus of $0.21.
-- Rodman said the higher earnings outlook reflects higher gross margin estimates.
-- Micron Electronics shares were up 3/8 at 19.
